tei:div.tei:p: 0* !0* "0* #0* na mo gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ye/

'dus byas kyi dge rtsa mchis so cog las phan yon khyad par du che ba sems can gyi srog bslu zhing skyob pa nyid yin la/ de'i bye brag nor phyugs tshe thar btang bas dud 'gro de nyid 'phral du srog gi 'jigs pa las grol cing*/ dkon mchog la phul ba dang mtshan dang gzungs sngags thos pa'i byin rlabs kyis mthar thug ngan 'gro'i skye gnas las thar par 'gyur ba dang de'i mthu dang rgyu mthun gyi 'bras dus byed pa po rang nyid tshe ring du 'phel ba sogs phan yon dpag med thob par the tshom med la/ de'ang cho ga dang 'brel na 'gyur stobs lhag par che bas/ skabs 'dir thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel gyi bla ma chos sku'i las 'byung ba ltar bkod na/ tshe thar gang yod kyi rna ba la sogs par dar ras kyis brgyan/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas srog chags rnams la chu gtsang 'thor/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ chos rnams mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang : sha khrag drod dbugs sems dang bcas: yongs su rdzogs pa'i srog chags rnams: ngo bo gdod nas yum lnga'i dngos: rnam pa rigs lnga'i phung po ni: rang rang byed gzugs yongs rdzogs pa: 'dod yon dpag med 'phro ba yi: mdun gyi nam mkhar gzhal yas khang : mtshan rdzogs rgyan gyis spras pa'i nang : sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i steng : glang chen seng ge rta mchog dang : rma bya shang shang gis btegs pa'i: rin chen khri rkang pad+ma dang : nyi ma zla ba'i gdan gyi dbus: bcom ldan rigs lnga tshe dpag med: dkar mthing ser dmar ljang ba'i mdog: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gis: 'chi med tshe yi bum pa 'dzin:

rang 'od yum mchog dbyings phyug lnga: rang rtags tshe bum bsnams pas 'khril: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras: rdo rje pad+ma'i skyil krung gis: 'od zer 'khrugs pa'i grong na bzhugs: phyi rol pad+ma 'dab brgyad la: sgeg sogs mchod pa'i lha mo dang : sgo bzhir rdo rje mgyogs ma bzhi: bar mtshams rtsa gsum tshe yi lha: byin rlabs gzi brjid 'bar ba yi: gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan: de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis: ye shes lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing : bdud sde dpung bcas mi zad 'joms mdzad lha: dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i: bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sa mā dza: dza:hūm̐ bam̐ ho: a ti pu ho: pra ti dza ho: oṃ: dngos 'byor yid las byung ba yi: kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin gyis: chos dbyings rgyas par bkang byas te: 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs mchod: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghṃ: pād+yaṃ: pūṣ+pe: dhū pe: ā lo ke: gan+dhe: nai wi d+ye: shab+da oṃ āḥhūm̐: sha khrag drod dbugs sems dang bcas: yongs su rdzogs pa'i srog chags rnams: ngo bo gdod nas yum lnga'i dngos: rnam pa rigs lnga'i phung po ni: rang rang byad gzugs yongs rdzogs pa: 'dod yon dpag med 'phro ba rnams: rigs lnga tshe yi dkyil 'khor lhar: gus pa'i tshul gyis 'bul lags na: dgyes pa chen pos rab bzhes nas: gnas skabs 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa dang : mthar thug 'khor ba ngan song gi: sdug bsngal kun las skyabs mdzad gsol: ces dang tshe dpag med rigs lnga'i sngags/ oṃ bud+dha ā yudzñān tshe bh+rum̐: oṃ badz+ra ā yudzñān tshe bh+rum̐: oṃ rat+na ā yudzñān tshe bh+rum̐: oṃ pad+ma ā yudzñān tshe bh+rum̐: oṃ karma ā yudzñān tshe bh+rum̐: zhes dang tshe gzungs bzla: oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ a pa ri mi ta a yur+dzñā na su bi ni sh+tsi ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/

ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ puṇ+ye puṇ+ye/ ma hā puṇ+ye/ a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ye/ a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ye dzñā na saṃ bha ro pa tsi te/ oṃ sarba saṃ skā ra pa ri shud+dha dharmā te ga ga na sa mud+ga te swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe ma hā na ya pa ri wa re swā hā/ bdag gi thugs nas 'od 'phros pas: mdun bskyed rgyud bskul 'od zer gyis: srid zhi'i khams kyi tshe bcud dang : khyad par 'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud kun: bsdus te bdag dang bsgrub byar thim: khams lnga nyams pa sor chud nas: rigs lnga'i tshe dbang thob par 'gyur: ces brjod cing bsams mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghṃ: pād+yaṃ: pūṣ+pe: dhū pe: ā lo ke: gan+dhe: nai wi d+ye: shab+da oṃ āḥhūm̐: ye shes lnga yi ngo bo nyid: bcom ldan rigs lnga tshe dpag med: khams lnga rnam dag yum dang sbyor: tshe bdag rigs lnga'i tshogs la bstod: bcom ldan tshe yi lha tshogs kyis: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams: tshe bsod nyams pa sor chud nas: rigs lnga'i tshe dbang dngos grub stsol: zhes bstod cing gsol ba gdab mthar/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i 'chi med tshe yi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa bde ba chen po'i ngo bor 'od du zhu/ rang dang bsgrub bya la thim pas khams lnga nyams pa sor chud/ rigs lnga'i tshe dang ye shes kyi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par gyur/ ces brjod cing nges shes bskyed/ mthar smon lam dang shis brjod rgyas par spel la me tog 'thor ro// ston mchog dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa// sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa// chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /tshogs kyi dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa// dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog

/sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /gnas 'dir nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyin mo'i gung yang bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa// dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog /na moḥbud+dha ya/ na moḥdharma ya/ na moḥsaṅghā ya/ mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ trā sa ni trā sa ni/ pra ti han pra ti han/ sarba karma pa raṃ pa rā ni me sarba sat+t+wā nañtsa swā hā/ kun rig gi gzungs/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga te pā ri shwa dha ni rā dza ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ shwa dha ni shwa dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ bi shwa dha ni shud+dhe bi shud+dhe sarba karma a wā ra ṇa bi shwa dha ne swā hā/ sangs rgyas sman bla'i gzungs/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dz+ye bhai ṣa dz+ye ma hā bhai ṣa dz+ye rā dza sa muṅga te swā hā/ oṃ āḥmi dhe wa hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ār+ya dzñā na/ sā ga ra bai ro tsa na/ byū ha rā dza ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ ar+ha te bh+yaḥ samyak+saṃ bud+dhe bh+yaḥ na ma ār+ya a wa lo ki shwa ra ya/ bo d+dhi so t+t+wā ya/ ma hā sa t+t+wā ya/ ma hā kā ru ni kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ iṭ+ṭe wiṭ+ṭe/ tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su me ku su me wa re/ i li mi li tsi te dz+wa la ma pa na ya swā hā/ zhi khro'i yang snying gzungs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbodhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: btags grol snying po/ 'a:a:sha:sa:ma:ha: rdor sems yi ge brgya pa/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra sa twa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/

su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra ya ts+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shri yaḥ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wā na/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa badz+rī bhā wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ sems can ngan song sdug bsngal mi 'byung zhing*// dka' ba spyad pa med pa yis// lha bas lhag pa'i lus thob nas// de dag sangs rgyas myur thob shog// / bsngo smon shis brjod bcas bya/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ dge legs 'phel/// /
